summary: This clinical trial compares the study drug BGM0504 to semaglutide in adults with type 2 diabetes who are already taking metformin. Type 2 diabetes is a long-term condition where the body does not use insulin properly to control blood sugar. Metformin is a common medication used to help lower blood sugar levels in these patients. BrightGene Bio-Medical Technology Co., Ltd. is sponsoring this Phase 3 study with 152 participants.
